data.name: Akawalli, the Seething Tower
data.oracle_text:
Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, Akawalli gets +2/+2 and has trample.
Descend 8 — As long as there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard, Akawalli gets an additional +2/+2 and can't be blocked by more than one creature.

data.name: Basking Capybara
data.oracle_text: Descend 4 — This creature gets +3/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
data.flavor_text:
"Even our most learned philosophers can only hope to approach the inner serenity of the humble capybara."
—Nelli, Oltec didact

data.name: Coati Scavenger
data.oracle_text: Descend 4 — When this creature enters, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
data.flavor_text: The difference between trash and treasure is a matter of perspective.

data.name: Council of Echoes
data.oracle_text:
Flying
Descend 4 — When this creature enters, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, return up to one target nonland permanent other than this creature to its owner's hand.
data.flavor_text: The Komon Winaq, ancestors of the Oltec, linger on as the eldest of the Echoes.

data.name: Didact Echo
data.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, draw a card.
Descend 4 — This creature has flying as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
data.flavor_text: The folk of the Sun Empire respect their ancestors. The Oltec go further, communing with spirits of esteemed elders after death.

data.name: Echo of Dusk
data.oracle_text: Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
data.flavor_text:
"It's a mournful fate, to remember so well the taste of blood yet be forever unable to drink."
—Bartolomé del Presidio, director of the Queen's Bay Company

data.name: Frilled Cave-Wurm
data.oracle_text: Descend 4 — This creature gets +2/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
data.flavor_text:
"Remember that weird salamander thing we found in the jungle stream? I think we just met its god."
—Carella, quartermaster of the *Windshark*

data.name: Join the Dead
data.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.
Descend 4 — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
data.flavor_text: The more creatures that plunge to their deaths in the abyss, the more angry Echoes that arise to drag others down.

data.name: Malamet Veteran
data.oracle_text:
Trample

data.flavor_text: The mightiest Malamet warriors train as titan-killers, elite champions capable of facing down the caverns' most fearsome beasts.

data.name: Stinging Cave Crawler
data.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
